description: Tar Solo: one human plus one AI. Claude Code is my AI co-pilot for code, physics and research. We build Mission: Mars, a browser game on NASA data (JPL Horizons, DSN, SOA 2026) that teaches mission design from school level to engineer level. Join us if you love space education, game design or orbital mechanics. Wanted: a UX/visual designer and an aerospace engineer or science teacher to check the facts.
